input.noiseRecipe: float32((((i*29+7)%127)-63)/64), i=0..127; caller-owned explicit array; no PRNG
input.conditioning: target-only; context_latents=[]; text dependency outside prefix cut

target.omissionReason: post-norm1-modulation self-attention input depends only on shift chunk0 and scale chunk1; residual/FFN and full block not accepted

precision.parameterStorage: F16 for this prefix; no FP8 weight-scale conversion on these keys
precision.parameterDecode: IEEE754 binary16 -> owned float32; strict F32 bytes
precision.normalize: source constants F32; subtraction, multiply1, divide std rounded after each operation
precision.patch: F32 im2col, ORT runtime-input Gemm; no convolution/CUDA/TF32 parity claim
precision.linear: F32 ORT Gemm with F32 bias; independent binary64 dot -> F32 then F32 bias add
precision.timeSin: F32 exponent/arange division; pow primitive F64->F32; F32 position*frequency; cos/sin primitive F64->F32; cos then sin concat; distinct from RoPE F64 frequency
precision.silu: ORT Sigmoid then Mul F32; finite abs(input)<=1e6 and finite output; independent stable binary64 sigmoid*x -> F32; no fused Torch SiLU parity
precision.layerNorm: nonaffine full5120 epsilon1e-6; Hike two-pass orderedF32 mean/variance; sqrtF64->F32, inverseF32; independent binary64 mean/variance/sqrt -> F32
precision.modulate: F32 scalePlusOne, F32 norm*scalePlusOne then F32 add shift; independent binary64 product+sum -> F32; source addcmul/ck.adaln parity unverified
precision.shiftScale: F32 timeProjection plus decodedF32 blocks.0.modulation chunks0/1

admission.weightBinding: original key/full shape/F16 dtype/exact row range/model+header identity required
admission.privateArtifact: all actual numeric hidden/parameter arrays stay outside repository; public receipts contain hashes/metrics only

composedAttention.scope: independent raw-mean prefix hidden -> independent QKV/norm/RoPE/all40head N2 attention; separate from actual-hidden local boundary gates

gatesFormula: each element abs(actual-reference)<=abs+rel*abs(reference); no tolerance adjustment after observation

resources.resourceScope: streamed prefix only; combined downstream ORT/Hike/session/copy budget measured separately; not browser allocation proof for production N32760 or N65520

notAccepted: original81frame production input/noise/context and production hidden
FP8 activation/scaled_mm or BF16/FP16 original production precision
